summary_en: 3,000,000 common shares (7.11% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) cancelled effective 2026-08-31. Post-cancellation shares outstanding: 41,082,309.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Treasury Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: Kanro Inc. (TSE Standard: 2216) completed the cancellation of 3,000,000 treasury shares (common stock) effective 2026-08-31, pursuant to a board resolution passed on 2026-07-31 under Company Law Article 178. The cancelled shares represent 7.11% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury) as measured immediately before cancellation. Following the cancellation, shares outstanding (ex-treasury) total 41,082,309 shares.
